## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS account_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsCurrent IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_accounts FROM DimAccount GROUP BY Status ORDER BY Status
```
